jobs.title: Associate Security Researcher
jobs.description_text:
Description

At Cobalt, our Offensive Security Research team bridges the gap between emerging adversary tradecraft, automated security validation, and real-world penetration testing. We do not need a narrow, single-domain specialist for this seat. We are looking for a high-agency, multi-skilled Associate Security Researcher who loves building, scripting, testing, and solving practical technical problems across the stack.

Think of this role as a technical utility player for Offensive Security Research. One day you will build containerized lab environments in Docker and GCP or wire up Python scripts to benchmark emerging offensive security tools and AI models. The next day you will collaborate with Senior Researchers to validate vulnerability findings, refine testing methodologies (Web, API, Cloud, IoT, and AI/LLM), and review specialized penetration testing reports for technical accuracy. You will bring broad foundational skills across systems, code, and security, and we will mentor you into a full-scale Security Researcher.

What You’ll Do

  • Research Infrastructure & Lab Engineering: Build, deploy, and maintain containerized testing harnesses, vulnerable lab targets, and cloud sandboxes (Docker, Linux, GCP/AWS) to support tool bake-offs and vulnerability research.
  • Tooling & Workflow Automation: Write and maintain practical scripts in Pytho

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  

What to know:

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.

  • Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. jobs.title: Loading Dock Attendant (M-F 7am-4pm)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

This role is crucial for ensuring the smooth operation of residential moves and maintaining the overall upkeep of our property. The ideal candidate will be responsible for coordinating the arrival and departure of moving trucks, scheduling and monitoring on-site movers, and protecting property during deliveries and moves. Additional responsibilities include managing bulk material pickups, conducting daily residential garage inspections, and ensuring building security through routine FOB checks. The Loading Dock Attendant will also liaise with vendors for routine cleaning schedules, report incidents to the property manager, and submit maintenance tickets for timely resolution. Flexibility to assist with various tasks as assigned by the property manager and the engineering & operations team is essential. 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Coordinate the arrival and departure of moving trucks 
  • Coordinate residential move in and move outs, to include scheduling and monitoring on site movers
  • Protect doors and floors during deliveries and moves
  • Coordinate pickups and removal of bulk material items from loading dock and trash room areas
  • Report incidents or accidents to property manager as needed 
  • Complete daily Residential garage inspections and provide inspection report to manager
  • Manage routine cleaning schedules by vendor

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

Join our dedicated maintenance team at a luxury apartment community, where exceptional service and high-quality living standards are top priorities. We are seeking a skilled Maintenance Technician with experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance repair, and general carpentry. This role requires a proactive problem-solver who can perform preventative maintenance and respond to work orders efficiently and professionally. A strong commitment to customer service, clear communication, and a polished, resident-first attitude are essential in maintaining our five-star living environment. #WeShowUp

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Class “A” customer service – building a good rapport with residents and going above and beyond whenever possible
  • Perform repairs, maintenance, and cleaning of property both interior and exterior
  • Protect and assist in improving the value of the client’s assets
  • Perform PM on unit based and building level equipment
  • Perform emergency on-call service in a rotation order 
  • Perform electrical, plumbing, carpentry, masonry and painting
  • Repair and treat structures such as showers, sinks, appliances, doors/cabinets, walls and building exteriors
  • Make ready units for new move-ins
  • Complete grounds work such as grounds pick up, sweeping and light landscaping
  • Perform other duties as assigned

회사 소개 (Who we are)

과거에는 성공적인 레스토랑 경영자가 되기 위해 음식과 사람에 대한 열정만 있으면 충분했습니다. 하지만 디지털 시대의 레스토랑 경영자로 성공하기 위해서는 기술에 대한 열정도 필요합니다.우리는 고객에게 서비스를 제공하는 과정에서 얻는 기쁨을 믿습니다. 그리고 이러한 믿음을 바탕으로 레스토랑 사업자들이 온라인 음식 배달 시장에서 성공할 수 있도록 돕기 위해 Otter를 만들었습니다.

Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry’s, KFC, Eataly 등 전 세계의 크고 작은 레스토랑들이 배달 사업 운영을 위해 Otter의 소프트웨어를 신뢰하고 사용하고 있습니다.

Otter는 레스토랑의 매출을 높이고, 주문 관련 문제를 줄이며, 배달 운영 과정에서 발생하는 다양한 어려움을 해결합니다.

 

직무 개요 (About the role)

Digital Onboarding Associate는 신규 레스토랑 파트너의 영업 인계(Sales Handoff) 단계부터 성공적인 서비스 출시(Go-live)까지 온보딩 전 과정을 담당하는 역할입니다.

이 직무는 기술 설정, 운영 준비, 파트너 교육 및 프로젝트 전반에 대한 책임을 중심으로 합니다. 이를 통해 가맹점이 효율적으로 서비스를 출시하고, 가능한 한 빠르게 매출을 창출할 수 있도록 지원합니다.

 

주요 업무 (What you’ll do)

  • 신규 SMB(중소형 레스토랑) 파트너의 영업 인계부터 서비스 출시까지 온보딩 전 과정을 담당하고, 파트너의 주요 커뮤니케이션 창구 역할을 수행합니다.
  • 여러 온보딩 프로젝트를 동시에 관리하며 SLA 목표, 서비스 활성화 목표 및 품질 기준을 준수합니다.
  • POS 시스템, 키오스크, 태블릿, 메뉴 관리 플랫폼 및 배달 플랫폼 연동을 설정하여 정확하고 안정적인 시스템 환경을 구축합니다.
  • 메뉴, 가격, 옵션(Modifiers), 세금 및 주문 처리 프로세스를 설정하고, 서비스 출시 전 실제 운영에 문제가 없는지 검증합니다.
  • 레스토랑 점주, 매니저 및 직원을 대상으로 실시간 온보딩 세션과 교육을 진행하여 제품 활용도와 운영 이해도를 높입니다.
  • Sales, Implementation, Product, Support, Revenue Operations 등 유관 부서와 협업하여 문제를 해결하고 원활한 온보딩 및 업무 인계를 지원합니다.
  • 온보딩 과정에서 발생하는 비효율이나 문제점을 파악하고, 문서화, 표준 운영 절차(SOP) 작성 및 업무 프로세스 최적화를 통해 지속적인 개선에 기여합니다.

jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

At Kitchen Park, our mission is centered on enhancing affordability, quality, and convenience for all. By repurposing underutilized properties into smart, fully equipped kitchens, we empower restaurateurs to thrive in the evolving food delivery landscape while delivering better experiences to customers and local communities.

We offer customized kitchen spaces designed for modern chefs and restaurant owners looking to tap into or scale within the delivery market. Our facilities support the production of virtually all cuisine types and can be tailored in both layout and equipment to meet specific operational needs. As our partners grow, we grow with them—providing flexible solutions that support expansion at every stage.

 

About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented  Analyst in our Real Estate division to support our team in sourcing new properties across Qatar, evaluating investment opportunities, and providing strategic insights. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in market analysis (ideally commercial real estate), financial modelling, and data-driven decision-making.

Join one of the fastest-growing FoodTech teams in the world and help us revolutionize the food industry! We're building the infrastructure for better food in every major city of the world, and Qatar is one of the fastest growing markets for us.

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. We’re growing fast and excited to bring on world-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description_text:
Fortera is transforming one of the world’s largest industries by reinventing how cement is made. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Fortera has developed next-generation cement technology that delivers high performance while reducing CO₂ emissions by up to ~70%. By mineralizing CO₂ and turning it into a productive feedstock, Fortera converts emissions into a valuable building material, creating a more sustainable path for modern construction.

With our commercial ReCarb® plant operating in Redding, California, and a growing global project pipeline, Fortera is moving from first-of-a-kind deployment to scaled commercialization. Our technology is already being used in real-world infrastructure applications, bringing next-generation cement into use today while expanding toward broader adoption.

At Fortera, you’ll work alongside scientists, engineers, operators, and industry experts who are turning cutting-edge materials science into real-world impact. We’re looking for curious thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers who want to help tackle one of the biggest challenges facing our planet.

This is more than a job. It’s an opportunity to help shape the future of sustainable construction.

Build What’s Next.

Visit www.forteraglobal.com to learn more.

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Recruiting Manager you will cultivate, lead, mentor, grow, and hire a team of recruiting professionals supporting multiple business functions across Sales in EMEA. You will work from conception to fruition on staffing strategies to support these organizations and partner with our hiring leaders to execute top of class recruiting practices. Figma's continued future success relies heavily on the ability to scale and the talent acquisition team is at the helm of the ship.

This is a full time role that will be based in our London Hub.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Manage, mentor, and develop a growing team of recruiters
  • Collaborate with Sales leadership to understand business needs and align recruiting resources accordingly in order to achieve goals
  • Partner with recruiting leaders to develop a talent brand strategy that continues to bring in exceptional talent to Figma

jobs.title: 2027 Digital Infrastructure Intern - NYC
jobs.description_text:
Who We Are:

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

  • Seek Excellence.
  • Be Selective To Be Effective.
  • Be High

jobs.description_text:
About General Atlantic

General Atlantic is a leading global investor with more than four and a half decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 885 companies throughout its history. Established in 1980, General Atlantic continues to be a dedicated partner to visionary founders and investors seeking to build dynamic businesses and create lasting value. Guided by the conviction that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change, the firm combines a collaborative global approach, sector specific expertise, a long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with and scale innovative businesses around the world. The firm leverages its patient capital, operational expertise, and global platform to support a diversified investment platform spanning Growth Equity, Infrastructure, and Strategic Solutions. General Atlantic manages approximately $126 billion in assets under management, inclusive of all strategies, as of March 31, 2026, with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across five regions.
